decisions.reason: Data format reader and writer plug-ins are low-maintenance extensions of the firm's core GIS integration business, and having a dedicated page signals ongoing commitment.
A building data digital twin service is a growth area for a GIS consultancy, though it gets only a mention and is more exploratory, so there is moderate risk it is folded into other offerings.
Authentication and identity delegation is infrastructure that customers rely on once deployed, but it overlaps with Product E and might be merged with it.
An open GIS application development framework underpins the firm's project work and is unlikely to be withdrawn within a year of launch.
The identity service for GIS applications was actively promoted at launch and fits con terra's GeoIT integration strategy, so it is likely to be retained.
